_help: Edit the 'text' of any line to change what the caller hears. To use YOUR OWN VOICE instead of the computer voice, record the line, save it as an MP3 in public/audio/ using the file name shown in 'audio', and it will be played automatically. Missing audio files fall back to the computer voice reading 'text'. 'website' is the key that texts the caller a link to the website. 'sms' holds those text messages ({link} and {service} are filled in automatically). 'questions' are asked one by one after the caller picks a service: add, remove or reorder them freely ('label' is the short name shown in your dashboard, 'maxSeconds' is how long they can answer). See VOICE-SCRIPT.md.
_voiceHelp: Computer voice used for any line you haven't recorded. 'Polly.Matthew-Generative' is Amazon's most natural-sounding male voice on Twilio. Other natural options: 'Polly.Stephen-Generative' (male), 'Polly.Ruth-Generative' or 'Polly.Danielle-Generative' (female). Your own MP3 recordings always sound best.

greeting.text: Hi there, and thank you for calling Selfie TV Boss Entertainment! We're so glad you reached out about booking Selfie TV Boss for your event.

menu.text: So, how can we help you today? For project management, press 1. To book Selfie TV Boss as your host, press 2. For a D J, press 3. For entertainment, press 4. For movie and on-camera work, press 5. For promotions, press 6. If you'd like our website link sent to you by text, press 7. And to speak with Selfie TV Boss himself, press 0. You can press star at any time to hear these options again.

noInput.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Let me go over the options one more time.

invalid.text: Hmm, that's not one of the options. Let's try that again.

linkSent.text: We've also just sent you a text with a link to book online.

questionsIntro.text: Now, I just have a few quick questions, so Selfie TV Boss can get back to you with the right package. After each beep, go ahead and answer, then press the pound key when you're done.

thanks.text: That's everything! Thank you so much. Selfie TV Boss will be in touch with you very soon. In the meantime, you can also book online at selfie T V boss dot com. Have a wonderful day!

connecting.text: Sure thing! Please hold for just a moment while I connect you to Selfie TV Boss.

ownerUnavailable.text: It looks like Selfie TV Boss is tied up right now, but don't worry, he'll call you right back.

goodbye.text: It seems now isn't a good time, and that's no problem at all. You can always visit selfie T V boss dot com to book. Take care!

voicemail.text: Hi, this is Selfie TV Boss Entertainment. We'd love to help with your next event, whether you need a host, a D J, an entertainer or promotions. Give us a call back at this number, or visit selfie T V boss dot com to book online. Talk soon!

options.text: Great choice! Selfie TV Boss can take care of your whole event for you, from planning and vendors right through to the run of the show.
Awesome! Selfie TV Boss would love to host your event. Whether it's a stage show, a party, a launch or an awards night, he'll bring the energy and keep the crowd going.
Let's turn it up! Selfie TV Boss will D J your event and keep the dance floor packed all night long.
Wonderful! Selfie TV Boss brings the comedy, the crowd games and the fun, so everybody feels like part of the show.
Lights, camera, action! Selfie TV Boss is available for film, T V, commercials and music videos.
Let's get your event seen! Selfie TV Boss can promote your show on camera, across social media, and live on the scene.

website.text: Perfect! We've just sent you a text with a link to our website. You can see Selfie TV Boss in action, check out upcoming events, and book online any time. Thanks so much for calling, and have a great day!
